people.gloss: The red bean of longing (Vương Duy)
people.role: Mistress of Hồng Đậu Trang since 910: poisons and charms behind a gracious door (ma đạo); holder of Phi Hồng
people.appearance: A tall woman in red silk with a voice like warm water, who pours tea with both hands and has not aged a day in three hundred years.
people.backstory: Nghê Hồng Đậu was born in Thu Trì Thành in 800, and red beans grew from the cracks in her mother's doorstep that spring (A273). Her mother kept a teahouse on the autumn pools, two doors from the inn where Kiều Mãn Lâu (kieu_man_lau) would be born. The Tower's elders drank there, and the girl who poured for them learned what cultivators say in front of furniture. Her Wood root was strong, and no one at the Tower asked for it. In 910 she found Phi Hồng in the rain forest, where Diệp Phi Hồng (diep_phi_hong) had left it to wait for an heir (C133, C168). She could not open its art. She planted beans around it instead, built a manor with a gracious door on the forest road, and opened that door to every sect (A275). She wrote her own canon so as not to need the sword's. In 1012 she took the Tower's toad-wood alchemist Ô Thiềm Tử (o_thiem_tu) as a lover for one season. Every winter she pours one cup of tea for the Tower's first elder Quan Vũ Thanh (quan_vu_thanh), and never a second. In 1110 she moved her own rooms back from the door to the vein garden at Tiêu Âm Mạch (N-hong_dau-03).
people.wants: Tàn Hồng, the other sword. With both she could call herself heir of Lạc Anh Phái, and with that name claim the forest that the Pivot gave the Tower in 620.
people.secret: Her daughter's father is Ô Thiềm Tử, and he has never been told. And the guests who stay too long are not dead: they tend the beans in the back garden, under the charm of the second cup.

people.role: Mistress of the back garden at Tiêu Âm Mạch: the bean trellises, the poison beds and the gardeners who do not leave
people.appearance: A thin woman with earth under her nails and a hat of banana leaf, who looks at people the way she looks at a trellis that needs cutting back.
people.backstory: Nghê Xuân Chi was born in the vein garden at Tiêu Âm Mạch in 1013, and the manor was told she was a foundling from the bean beds. She was raised among the trellises and has never cared for the front door. She took the garden from her mother at Trúc Cơ, and in 1101 she reached Kết Đan among the vines. At forty she ate a toad-wood venom that should have killed her and felt only warm. That, her root and the shape of her hands told her who her father was. Since then she has bought every new poison Ô Thiềm Tử (o_thiem_tu) makes through his apprentice Mai Độc Ca (mai_doc_ca), and sends him her own through the market under no name. She thinks the gracious door is a vanity. The beans grow without guests. Every guest kept in the garden is a sect that will one day come looking. She has told her mother so (nghe_hong_dau), and her mother laughed.
people.wants: To be mistress after her mother, to close the second cup, and to send the gardeners home before someone comes for them.
people.secret: She knows her father is Ô Thiềm Tử, and she has been answering his poisons with hers for a hundred and fifty years. He thinks his rival is a stranger in the market.

people.role: Mistress of the gracious door at the manor house (27): she greets the guests and pours the tea
people.appearance: Round-faced and laughing, in rose silk, with a fan she never opens all the way.
people.backstory: A fishmonger's girl from Lạc Triều Thôn whom Nghê Hồng Đậu (nghe_hong_dau) took for her face and kept for her nerve. For sixty years she has kept the manor house on the forest road: the gracious door, the tea, and the choice of who is poured a second cup. In 1153 she poured one for a Phượng Minh spy, Tề Vong Quy (te_vong_quy), and he has gardened for the manor ever since. She thinks Nghê Xuân Chi would close the door, and she means to be at the mistress's side when the succession comes.
people.wants: The second cup poured forever, and Nghê Xuân Chi's garden brought under her door.
people.secret: She wets Tề Vong Quy's (te_vong_quy) night tea with a sleeping draught so he does not wander the guests' wing in the dark.

people.appearance: A squat, silent man with toad-skin gloves and stained teeth.
people.backstory: Raised by toad-catchers in Độc Thiềm Lâm, the wood that bred Ô Thiềm Tử (o_thiem_tu) a hundred and seventy years before him, and sold to the manor at twelve for a jar of venom. He renders the red beans into the manor's longing poison in the garden at Tiêu Âm Mạch and does not ask whom it is for. He resents that the Tower's market buys Ô's poisons at twice the price of his.
people.wants: Ô's price paid at his own stall, and the garden's pastes sold under his name.
people.secret: He sells his pastes at the Night Rain Market under Ô Thiềm Tử's (o_thiem_tu) mark at Ô's price, thinned by a third with garden water.

people.role: A Phượng Minh disciple who came to the gracious door in 1153 and has gardened there since
people.appearance: A tall man in a gardener's apron with a Fire sword's calluses on his right hand and a red bean on a string at his throat.
people.exception: servant (tạp dịch), held by the manor's charm since 1153; a Phượng Minh disciple, never taught the lineage
people.backstory: In 1153, the fourth year of the Tower's war for Đan Sơn Mạch (C188), Phượng Minh sent him down the forest road to learn what the Tower's poisons were. He knocked at the gracious door, and Liễu Đa Thải (lieu_da_thai) poured him a second cup. He has tended the bean trellises at Tiêu Âm Mạch for forty-seven years and believes he loves her. He had a daughter by a garden servant, Tề Niệm Quy (te_niem_quy), who has spent her life trying to wake him.
people.wants: His daughter gone from the garden before anyone learns whose she is, and one night with his sword in the open.
people.secret: He has found out Tề Niệm Quy (te_niem_quy) is the one scattering the beans, and walks the path behind her each night picking up the ones she drops; he tips Liễu Đa Thải's (lieu_da_thai) night tea into the trellis so that he can.

people.backstory: A Thu Trì boy who followed Nghê Hồng Đậu (nghe_hong_dau) into the forest in 910 and stayed as her disciple and lover for a hundred and fifty years. In 1062 he tried to carry Phi Hồng to Lạc Hà, where Lạc Anh's claim on the Petal Shore would have bought him a seat. She caught him at the door and poured him a cup with one red bean in it (N-hong_dau-02). He is buried under the first trellis.
